## Description {#details}

<p>This class represents the number of cycles per resource (fractions of cycles).</p>


<p>That quantity is managed here as a ratio, and accessed via the double cast-operator below. The two quantities, number of cycles and number of resources, are kept separate. This is used by the ResourcePressureView to calculate the average resource cycles per instruction/iteration.</p>


<p>Definition at line 51 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mca/support-h">Support.h</a>.</p>
